# P7-B final scorecard (generated)

The complete tables behind [VC_BENCHMARKS.md → P7-B final scorecard of the shipped defaults](../../../docs/benchmarks/VC_BENCHMARKS.md#p7-b-final-scorecard-of-the-shipped-defaults): every profile target with its per-pass median and spread, the rows derived from the reports (what the output queue delivered, the H1 simulation's over-budget half), the delivery of the converted audio by run, the T5 (scorer v2) rows per execution provider, the CPU F0 comparison, the per-call stage table, every decision session and the load log of every step. `disturbed` marks a step that ran beside a compiler or a busy desktop; none did.

Executable `f1132368dc0c73a4`, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 617.14, 3120 MHz, 450.00 W, P8, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor           ; passes: once, pass1, pass2, pass3.
